prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Need effective and experinced website developers for business ROI scheme in the UK.
We are looking for very comminted and effeicent workers who will be able to create many different websites for my business at a high standard of work and flexibilty. My business idea is simple but incredible, it will become a ROI business which is when, we look to help business around the UK build a website enabling them to promote their business on a larger scale meaning that they will appeal to a wider audience. The four main business we will be trying to market for are: 1. Law Firms 2. Restaurants 3. Gyms 4. Barber shops.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern websites and web applications that are clean, reliable, and built to support business growth. Your project stands out because it has a clear focus: creating high-quality websites for UK businesses across several industries, and I’d be glad to help you build that out in a consistent and scalable way.

I work confidently with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, which gives me a strong foundation for creating fast, professional websites that look great and perform well. For a business model like yours, I understand the importance of delivering websites that are not only visually strong, but also structured to help clients present their services clearly, build trust, and attract a wider audience.

Since your focus includes law firms, restaurants, gyms, and barber shops, I’d approach each website with flexibility while keeping the overall standard high. Different industries need different layouts, messaging styles, and user journeys, but they all need to feel polished, easy to navigate, and built with the end customer in mind. I can help create websites that are adaptable across these business types while maintaining a consistent level of quality and professionalism.

I’m also comfortable working on projects that require repeated delivery of similar websites with careful attention to detail, which seems especially relevant for your ROI business model. If you need someone who can work efficiently, stay committed to the scope, and help turn your idea into something practical and scalable, I’d be a strong fit.

I value clear communication, flexibility, and dependable delivery. My goal is always to make the process smooth while producing work that meets a high standard. If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss how I can support your website development needs and help bring this business idea to life.
